issues.description: The problem statement's UML and its earlier attribute list specify a different attribute order than the constructor implemented in the solution. The exercise text explicitly instructs students to follow the UML order when implementing the constructor, but the solution's constructor uses a different parameter order (lectureName first). This mismatch can confuse students about the required constructor signature and lead to failing instantiations or tests if they follow the UML/instructions instead of the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Update the solution's constructor to follow the UML order (e.g. Lecture(int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors) and adjust assignments), or (B) update the UML/instruction text to list the attributes in the same order the solution uses (lectureName first). Ensure the template's TODO and the problem description consistently state the same parameter order so students know which constructor signature to implement.
